defects.description: The term 'safe value' is mistranslated as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note).
The term 'applied defaults' is mistranslated as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию' (applied remarks by default).
Complete mistranslation of technical constraints: 'explicitly set, never inferred' translated as 'явно задача, никогда не выводится' (explicitly a task, never outputted).
